verdict.rationale: Unreal documents several first-party scriptable surfaces an agent can use. Python editor scripting automates the placement, layout and settings of Actors in Levels. The Remote Control API exposes the engine over HTTP/WebSocket and can call any BlueprintCallable function. Builds can be triggered from the CLI through the cook commandlet and Unreal Automation Tool. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating new levels/scenes (only actor placement is shown), non-experimental status for the Python API, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive the editor and project programmatically — create scenes and nodes, edit properties, trigger builds — through a documented scriptable interface

citations.quote: Automate or randomize the placement, layout and settings of Actors in your Levels
Control the Unreal Editor from UIs that you create yourself in Python.

The Remote Control system makes this possible by running a web server inside the Unreal Engine that services WebSocket messages and HTTP requests made by remote web applications through a REST-like API.
You can call any function that is callable from Blueprint.
Unreal Automation Tool is a generic system used to automate processes, including testing and building games.
